edit.statement: 'Ranks pari passu with' is symmetric: if one debt ranks equally with another, the second ranks equally with the first.
edit.subject: ranksPariPassuWith
edit.scope: Equal-ranking claims between debts of the same issuer.

direct.prompt: Is the relation 'ranks pari passu with' (between debts) symmetric?

Los bonos senior de Ford con vencimiento en 2030 tienen rango pari passu con los bonos senior de Ford con vencimiento en 2032. ¿Se deduce que los bonos de 2032 tienen rango pari passu con los de 2030?
